title: Career Roadmap · Health Worker
summary: A Health Worker supports preventive healthcare, health education, community outreach, basic health-service delivery and referrals to appropriate medical facilities.

about.label: Education
about.text: Community-health training, ANM / GNM or a relevant public-health qualification, depending on the role.

blocks.label: Recommended stream
blocks.text: Any stream for some outreach roles; Biology is useful for clinical pathways.

blocks.label: Important subjects
blocks.text: Biology, English, nutrition, social science and health education.

blocks.label: Admissions
blocks.text: Depend on the course, employer and state recruitment rules.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Hygiene, sanitation, immunisation awareness, maternal-child health and disease prevention.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Communication, empathy, recordkeeping, teamwork and digital literacy.

items.text: Community Health Worker training → Outreach, health education and referral support.
ANM diploma → Auxiliary nursing and maternal-child health roles, subject to registration.
GNM diploma → General nursing pathway, subject to required registration.
B.Sc. Public Health / related degree → Public-health projects and programme support.
B.Sc. Nursing → Professional nursing pathway, subject to admission and registration requirements.

blocks.label: Important
blocks.text: “Health Worker” is a broad title. Required qualifications depend on whether the role involves community outreach, public-health programme delivery or regulated clinical duties.
Government / public options to investigate

items.text: National Health Mission (NHM) — state-specific health-worker training and recruitment.
Andhra Pradesh Health Department / NHM — community-health and field-worker notifications.
Government ANM / GNM schools in Andhra Pradesh — recognised nursing qualifications.
JIPMER, Puducherry — relevant nursing and public-health study options.
AIIMS institutions — nursing and public-health programmes.

blocks.text: Private / academic options to investigate

items.text: Public Health Foundation of India (PHFI) — public-health education and training.
Manipal Academy of Higher Education — public-health programmes.
Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham — relevant health-sciences programmes.
Sri Ramachandra Institute of Higher Education and Research — public-health education.
Recognised NGOs / healthcare training providers — structured training, where available.

blocks.text: These are research leads, not a ranking or confirmation of a specific Health Worker qualification at every institution. Verify current programmes, recognition and eligibility.

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Hygiene, nutrition, communication and community health needs.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Field skills
blocks.text: Outreach, beneficiary records, referrals and health campaigns.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Supervised practice
blocks.text: Community visits, maternal-child health awareness and immunisation follow-up, as authorised.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Progression
blocks.text: Digital reporting, programme monitoring and further recognised training.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Community health-needs survey • Immunisation follow-up tracker • Nutrition-awareness session • Referral completion dashboard.

blocks.label: Government / public
blocks.text: Primary Health Centres, Health and Wellness Centres, district health programmes and community outreach initiatives.

blocks.label: Private / nonprofit
blocks.text: Public-health NGOs, charitable clinics, community programmes and health-awareness projects.

blocks.label: Ideal exposure
blocks.text: Health education, community surveys, maternal-child health, sanitation awareness and referral support.
Placements and vacancies depend on programme rules, supervision, location and qualifications.

blocks.label: Distinction
blocks.text: ANM, GNM, ASHA and other health-worker roles have different qualifications, duties and recruitment procedures.

Master of Public Health (MPH), subject to entry requirements

blocks.text: Useful training

The Healthcare Sector Skill Council lists a Front Line Health Worker qualification among its healthcare job-role standards. Verify the current qualification version and its suitability for the intended job.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Academic qualifications, English proficiency where required, programme prerequisites, funding evidence and student-visa documentation. Verify current official admissions information.

blocks.label: Roles
blocks.text: Community Health Worker, Health Outreach Worker, Health Promotion Assistant, Public Health Project Assistant.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Community health services, public-health agencies, nonprofits and health research.
Local certification, language proficiency, background checks or additional training may be required. Employment and visa sponsorship are not guaranteed.

Community Health Trainee ↓ Community Health Worker ↓ Experienced Outreach Worker ↓ Senior Field Worker / Team Facilitator ↓ Public Health Programme Coordinator ↓ Programme Manager / Public Health Specialist
